koma.help_effect: He decreases damage taken from blades.
koma.quote: Effect: He decreases damage taken from blades.

koma.support_effect: Franky appears slightly in front of the character and, like his Down B, throws a circular table with 3 objects on it; if the table hits, it forcibly switches the opponent's character (about a 1 second delay).
koma.quote: Franky appears slightly in front of your character and like his Down B he throws a circular table, but this time he has 3 objects on the table. Also, if the table itself hits, it forcibly changes the opponents character.

koma.support_effect: Franky appears almost directly in front of the character and, after a chargeable .5-1.5 second load, charges the enemy with a punch; charge time increases distance and damage (no guard break).
koma.quote: after loading up for about .5 seconds – 1.5 seconds (depending on how long you hold down the button for him) he charges at the enemy and delivers a strong punch. The longer the button is held affects the overall distance and damage of the punch.

passives: Take more damage from lightning attacks.
Gain SP when being attacked by opponents.

specials.name: Coup de Vent
specials.description: He loads up air in his arms and shoots it forward with much velocity; decent sized, decent damage, moves him back a bit after launching, and has great knock back.
specials.quote: He loads up air in his arms and shoots it forward with much velocity. It’s a decent sized special with decent damage. Also, it moves him back a bit after he launches it and has great knock back.

specials.name: Ultimate Hammer
specials.description: He cracks his knuckles for .75 seconds and jumps forward diagonally (compared to Ichigo's Up X, but slower), grabs the opponent, and punches them down from the air.
specials.quote: He cracks his knuckles for .75 seconds and jumps forward diagonally (comparable to B. Ichigo’s Up X, but slower). He grabs the opponent and the punches them down from the air.

passives: Take more damage from lightning attacks.
Gain SP when being attacked by opponents.

specials.name: Coup de Vent
specials.description: Same move as the 4-koma version, just bigger and deals more damage. Great for ring outs, but has a slight startup.
specials.quote: Exact same as 4 koma, just bigger and deals more damage.

specials.name: Chaser Bullet
specials.description: Franky dislocates his shoulders to reveal holes and shoots multiple bullets while chasing the enemy; takes a second to start up, but is powerful and good for edge guarding since he can't run off stage while using it.
specials.damage: each hit 1 to knowledge/laughter (40 hits max = 40 total); each hit 1 or 2 to power (40 hits = 60 total)
specials.quote: He then shoots multiple bullets while chasing the enemy. ... Each hit deals 1 damage to knowledge/laughter and with 40 hits (max hits), its 40 damage total.

passives: Take more damage from lightning attacks.
Gain SP when being attacked by opponents.

specials.name: Coup de Vent
specials.description: Guide says same as the laughter variant.

specials.name: Chaser Bullet
specials.description: Guide says same as the laughter variant.

moves.name: Regular B
moves.description: A head butt that moves him forward a bit. A close range move.
moves.quote: A head butt that moves him forward a bit. A close range move.

moves.description: A simple straight punch that moves him forward a bit. A close range move.
moves.quote: A simple strait punch that moves him forward a bit. A close range move.

moves.description: He bends down, picks up a circular table, and throws it at the enemy; decent range, almost travels all the way across the screen.
moves.quote: He bends down and picks up a circular table and throws it at the enemy, has decent range and almost travels all the way across your screen.

moves.description: Shoots fire from his mouth aimed diagonally into the air; direction depends on facing. A close range move.
moves.quote: Shoots fire from his mouth aimed at the air diagonally, direction depends on which way you’re facing. A close range move.

moves.name: Jump B
moves.description: He jumps up and hits an opponent down with both hands (a double axe handle) and moves forward slightly. Rather close range, but the slight forward movement adds a bit more range.
moves.quote: He jumps up and hits an opponent down with both hands (a double axe handle) and moves forward slightly.

moves.name: Regular Y
moves.description: He goes into a boxer stance and punches the enemy a few times; the number of hits rises after each Ultimate Action use. A close ranged move.
moves.damage: 16 to knowledge/laughter, 24 to power; after 1 UA 27/40; after 2 UA 36/54
moves.quote: He will go into a stance like a boxer and punch the enemy a few times. The amount of hits rises after each UA.

moves.description: The tip of his finger flips up and he shoots a bullet that travels to the end of the screen. After 1 UA he shoots 3 cannon balls, after 2 UA a big cannon ball.
moves.damage: 14 to knowledge/laughter, 21 to power; after 1 UA 24/36; after 2 UA 33/49
moves.quote: The tip of his finger flips up and he shoots a bullet that travels till the end of your screen. After 1 UA he shoots 3 cannon balls and after 2 he shoots a big cannon ball.

moves.description: He stays still for 1 second then attacks with his right hand, a straight punch, staying in place. After 1 UA the punch detaches and flies further; after 2 UA it flies to the end of the screen.
moves.damage: 14 to knowledge/laughter, 21 to power; after 1 UA 21/31; after 2 UA 36/54
moves.quote: He will stay still for 1 second and then attack with his right hand. It’s a straight punch only and he stays in the same place. After 1 UA his punch detaches and flies further and after 2 it flies to the end of the screen.

moves.description: He loads for about half a second, fills his butt with gas, and propels himself into the air diagonally depending on facing; decent range, about twice the range of up B, and UA use increases the range a lot.
moves.damage: 16 to knowledge/laughter, 24 to power; after 1 UA 24/36; after 2 UA 30/45
moves.quote: He loads up for about half a second and fills his butt with gas and then fart/propels himself into the air in a diagonal line depending on which way you’re facing.

moves.name: Jump Y
moves.description: He jumps and breathes fire at a downward diagonal angle, much like Up B but from the air and facing down, with slightly more range; damage depends on number of hits connected (max 6). UA use raises max damage, not max hit count.
moves.damage: 1 hit 2/3 up to 6 hits 16/24; after 1 UA 1 hit 4/6 up to 5 hits 20/30; after 2 UA 1 hit 6/9 up to 5 hits 32/48
moves.quote: He jumps and breathes fire at a downwards diagonal angle... The damage of the move is hard to judge seeing as it depends on how many hits you connect (max of 6).

combos: B, -> B, Y, -> Y: 47 to knowledge/laughter, 70 to power. Can't use UA with this because the first Y sends the opponent flying.
B, Up B, Up Y, B: 41 to knowledge/power (as written), 61 to power. UA won't work because of extra distance.
After UA, B, -> B, Y: after 1 UA 44/66; after 2 UA 53/79.
After UA, B, Up B, -> Y: after 1 UA 40/60; after 2 UA 49/73 (best for ring outs after 2 UA).
After 2 UA, B, ? B, Y + Shishio 2 (used about halfway through), X: 4-koma 125 to knowledge/laughter, 152 to power; 5-koma 135/167.
After 2 UA, B, Up B, ? Y + Shishio 2, X: 4-koma 121/144; 5-koma 131/161.
unresolved: The combo 'B, Up B, Up Y, B' is written with damage '41 damage to knowledge/power' in the source, which looks like a typo for 'knowledge/laughter' given the pattern elsewhere; kept as written.
Guide states the 5-koma power variant is 'the exact same' as the laughter 5-koma except nature, so special descriptions/damage for the power variant were not independently given.
